How it works

LTA Rules & Regulations

Official transport regulations for all operators in the Fiji transport network.

Fare Regulations

All operators must adhere to the approved fare schedule published by LTA Fiji. Overcharging by any amount is a punishable offence. Drivers must provide correct change at all times.

Short Run Obligations

Drivers are legally obligated to complete any trip within their designated route regardless of distance. Refusing a passenger for a short run is a violation of public transport licensing conditions.

Road Safety Standards

All public transport vehicles must comply with LTA speed limits and road safety standards. Reckless driving or operating an unroadworthy vehicle is subject to immediate licence suspension.
